name: victrix
description: Follow and steer Claude's plan live: where it is, what it just did, and the assumptions that would change the plan.

push.description: Append Boris's three lines and the facts/guard/options/verify/slow tags to the plan-mode reminder
push.title: Push toward proofs

questions.description: Ask one gut-check question per new Claude-made fact or 2× option under the step being worked
questions.title: Gut-check questions

check.title: Check tool
check.description: Register the check tool Claude can call to turn a fact, guard or verify line into evidence (test, differential, fuzz, lean)

review.title: Review before each step
review.description: When a step finishes, Claude previews the next one in three lines with its premises and asks the questions that would change it before any tool call

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: The spinner on the running call, the breathing face and the arrival flash; off keeps every fact and drops the animation
